SELLING SURFACES | FY2018-Q3 2026 | G1-G4 overview
Spine: one back end; channel views are not a segment reconciliation
|
|-- G1 Thesis: extend one commerce system across selling surfaces
|   |-- [S] Adding channels reinforces other channels and embeds merchants.
|   |-- multi-channel -[D:claim]-> better outcomes / longer retention
|   `-- [I] No matched merchant comparison; selection may explain the claim.
|
|-- G2 Value engine: more entry points, more business on Shopify
|   |-- [S] Shared admin manages orders, returns and payments.
|   |-- [S] Arhaus moved from online into offline, B2B and Payments.
|   `-- [I] A cross-sell example supports possibility, not average uplift.
|
|-- Reported structure: rising adoption, changing measurement
|   |-- [R] FY19 >2/3 use; FY22 >80% installed; FY23 90% connected.
|   |-- [I] These verbs do not establish comparable active selling.
|   `-- [S] Q2 2021 ranking: online first, POS second, social/markets third.
|
|-- Online store: core surface
|   |-- [S] Seed: Hydrogen exceeded $1B GMV in Q4 2023.
|   |-- [S] Seed: Canvas built stores 20% faster in Q3 2026.
|   `-- [I] Those product figures lack matching pinned excerpts.
|
|-- Offline / POS: scaling physical retail
|   |-- [S] Revenue: $441M FY23 -> $588M FY24 -> $748M FY25.
|   |-- [S] FY23 definition includes payments, subscriptions and hardware.
|   |-- [I] Supplied excerpts cannot reconcile this view to audited totals.
|   |-- [X] Offline still consistently outgrows company GMV.
|   |-- [S] Q3 2026: $200B lifetime GMV; conflicting $300B passage.
|   `-- [S] Large multi-location merchants: locations +52% in Q3 2026.
|
|-- B2B: fast growth, limited disclosed scale
|   |-- [S] GMV growth: 2x FY23; >140% FY24; +96% FY25; +74% Q3 2026.
|   |-- [S] A small portion of GMV in Q4 2024; dollars not supplied.
|   |-- [S] Native B2B expanded beyond Plus in Q2 2026.
|   `-- [I] Migration from DTC workflows may relabel existing GMV.
|
|-- Social / marketplaces: distribution with uncertain materiality
|   |-- [S] Partner-checkout GMV: 5x, >3x, >2x in Q2-Q4 2022.
|   |-- [S] Management still described the base as small / nascent.
|   `-- [I] Later channel share and merchant-level uplift remain untested.
|
|-- AI channels: another surface in the seed
|   |-- [S] Seed: Agentic Storefronts reaches ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot.
|   `-- [I] Small scale / online-equivalent economics lack pinned support.
|
`-- Experiments and adjacent discovery surfaces
    |-- [S] NFTs beta; Collabs early access; Collective still cited in 2025.
    |-- [S] Shop GMV more than doubled in Q3 2026; shop.com announced.
    |-- [S] Early 3D test: interacting buyers >2x as likely to purchase.
    `-- [I] Missing methods and later status prevent impact/failure claims.

Key: [R] filing; [S] management; [I] inference; [X] contradicted claim.
Links retain mech / data / assoc / claim / untestable / contra grades.
[I] No controlled causal evidence supplied; seed-only claims marked.
